_: ELEC — CONSOLIDATED historical record, SOURCED FROM A VENDOR AND SAYING SO.
_ruling: Adopted on the principal's explicit instruction, 9 September 2026: 'Declare that the financials are from vendor and state specifically they are from investing.com'. SIGCM clause 1 forbids a vendor as the source of a company's own historicals. This is a NAMED, DECLARED exception for this one company, taken because the company's own statements cannot be obtained: FY2024 and FY2025 were never filed anywhere reachable, and every archived annual except FY2021 is truncated mid-file by the crawler.
_what_changes_and_what_does_not: What changes is that the figures are now ATTRIBUTED. Before this file, the same vendor numbers sat in the study tagged with the ring 'Company' — the register asserted company sourcing on figures it described in the same breath as coming from Simply Wall St and Investing.com. A declared vendor figure is honest; an undeclared one is not, and the undeclared version is what was there.
read_how: read off the rendered pages by the principal and supplied to this session as screenshots; the pages return HTTP 403 to automated access, so they were not fetched here
_basis_matters_more_than_the_source: This record is CONSOLIDATED. The defect it was brought in to fix is a basis mismatch: the study forecast margins on the STANDALONE entity (4.1% rising to 12.3%, inside the standalone filed range of 1.4-17.5%) and deducted CONSOLIDATED net debt of 9,805 against them. The two differ by 1.73x on revenue and 34.5x on operating profit. Standalone earnings cannot service consolidated debt, so equity went to -5,992, the cash-flow lens to -1.81 a share, and the published 0.3357 is what the floors left of it.
_footing_checks_to_run: gross profit = revenue less cost of revenues, every year
operating income = gross profit less other operating expenses, every year
EBITDA less depreciation = operating income, against the change in accumulated depreciation
total assets = total liabilities + total equity, every year
net income / weighted shares = the printed basic EPS, every year
retained earnings roll forward by net income where no dividend is printed
_what_is_still_owed: The company's own FY2021 annual statement is complete and readable in the archive and has NOT yet been read. It is the one year where this vendor record can be checked against the issuer's own filing, and until that is done nothing here has been verified against a primary source.
